t: This is St Paul's Churchyard, the street running around St Paul's Cathedral in the City of London. Samuel Butler, the English novelist and critic, is buried here. He is best known for the satirical utopian novel Erewhon, published in 1872, and for the semi-autobiographical The Way of All Flesh. Both have stayed in print ever since. He also wrote about Christian orthodoxy, evolutionary thought and Italian art, and his prose translations of the Iliad and Odyssey are still consulted today.
